stories.title: Michigan gas prices drop 24 cents in past week as Thanksgiving travel picks up
stories.summary: Michigan drivers are now paying an average of $3.57 per gallon for regular unleaded fuel, AAA says in its weekly price update.

stories.title: "The Game" features embattled coaches: Michigan's Kyle Whittingham and Ohio State's Ryan Day
stories.summary: "The Game" always has put a focus on coaches, most famously during Bo Schembechler and Woody Hayes' 10-Year War, but that doesn't seem to affect Whittingham entering his first visit to The Horseshoe.

stories.title: Michigan prepares to take on Ohio State
stories.summary: After beating UCLA, the Michigan Wolverines are preparing for one of the biggest games: the matchup against the Ohio State Buckeyes.

stories.title: Cold nights and cool days
stories.summary: Lows tonight dive into the 20s with chilly air hanging around this week.

stories.title: Rochesters Big, Bright Light Show returns
stories.summary: Downtown Rochester, Michigan, is now fully into the holiday spirit as the city holds its annual Big, Bright Light Show

stories.title: Gas prices in Michigan fluctuate before Thanksgiving travel
stories.summary: AAA says the average price of regular gas has dropped 24 cents from last week, and it comes as millions are expected to hit the road for Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Michigan Board of State Canvassers certifiy midterm electon results
stories.summary: The Michigan Board of State Canvassers unanimously certified the midterm election results on Monday, but not without some members of the public questioning the election's integrity.

stories.title: Appeals court clears way for Army to detonate Iowa lead azide explosives
stories.summary: A federal appeals court on Monday declined to block the Army from detonating explosives containing lead azide at a munitions plant in Iowa.

stories.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia said Monday that it has restored Jensen Huang as the chipmaker's chief executive, calling him the "right person" to lead the company.

stories.title: Trump tells Army to halt detonation for now of unstable explosives in Iowa
stories.summary: President Trump said he will wait for the courts and Iowa Gov.-elect Rob Sand to agree with the Army's plan.

stories.title: Why the Army says it needs to detonate unstable, lead-filled explosives in Iowa and what's at risk
stories.summary: The U.S. Army plans to detonate 68 drums of lead azide in Iowa despite local leaders and residents raising concerns.

stories.title: Volunteers pack hundreds of meals for annual Full Plates Full Hearts event in Detroit
stories.summary: While many restaurants are preparing for the holiday rush, dozens of volunteers spent Monday morning focused on a different Thanksgiving tradition.
